scope: One capacity exploration, one matched diagnostic pair, one full one-hour soak, then downshift; no worker/queue tuning
decision: Keep handoff default false; 4000 req/s inline failed one-hour zero-fail-open criterion. Lower rates and handoff have no one-hour pass in this round.

measurementConditions.note: CPU sets share the Docker Desktop VM and physical Windows host. Normal sampling is part of the measured conditions. Extra JFR/schedstat observation only in the diagnostic pair.

preregisteredPlan.scope: One capacity exploration and one targeted paired diagnostic comparison; no resource tuning iterations.
preregisteredPlan.modeOrder: A ascending, B ascending, B descending, A descending; A inline, B handoff
preregisteredPlan.warmup: each mode: preserve 30s cold/1000 and 30s idle-recovery/1000, then 30s 500 +30s 1000 +60s 2000; 15s 500 before each measured short phase
preregisteredPlan.selection: Highest rate passing both short repetitions for a mode. Tie chooses existing inline default. Run exactly one 3600s soak only if a mode qualifies; do not lower the bar after observing results.
preregisteredPlan.targeted: one matched 120s pair at 4000 with JFR+event sampling, recorded separately from capacity, no tuning of worker/pool/queue counts
preregisteredPlan.downshift: After soak, 120s at 500; verify all work/audit drains and pool idles; preserve soak failures.
preregisteredPlan.artifact: Freeze one final jar after diagnostics changes+tests; same hash for every new live measurement. Keep handoff default off.
